name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.3 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 9 times in 4 visits over 49 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 15 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.0 days starting 2025-06-16, at wavelengths from 0.76 to 3.80 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
